svg.desc: Source title: thermal-room temperature management. Internal labels repeat the guest-pool filling, draining, flow-meter and lighting diagram. This source inconsistency is retained; it is not a validated sauna control schematic. Specify thermal-room temperature/humidity sensing, heating, ventilation and protection separately.
